aiReview.summary: Official product page advertises a Black Friday lifetime-license sale for a desktop AI/cloud/SaaS cost monitor. The banner does not spell out a 2026 date window, so season year still needs a human check against the listed Nov–Dec 2026 window.
evidence: Official excerpt: “Black Friday: Lifetime … See plans” and pricing card “Black Friday, 50% off” on Solo Lifetime.
Footer includes “© 2026 CostGoat”; product described as privacy-first desktop monitoring with 75+ integrations.
Not VPN/hosting; sale window in source list ends 2026-12-01, after BF week start 2026-11-23.
uncertainty: Whether the live page currently states year 2026 or dates Nov 20–Dec 1, 2026.
Whether code FCBF26 is shown on the vendor site.
How long the Black Friday banner remains after Dec 1.
page content does not confirm a 2026 Black Friday / Cyber Monday deal; approve requires the fetched vendor page to state the current-season sale

cons: Fetched copy says Black Friday but does not explicitly state a 2026 sale window or end date.
Coupon code and exact Nov 20–Dec 1 window appear only in the third-party deal list, not in the excerpted vendor copy.

# Outlier pricing

Last updated 2026-11-20

By Matthew Kerr · founder, Outlier

Start with Free for everyday chat on your Mac. Choose Pro for the other four model tiers and every feature. Both plans run local AI on your own Mac. There is no monthly plan and no token bill.

## Free: Nano and Lite

Free costs $0 and stays free. It is for everyday private chat, with no account needed. It includes:

*   Nano 4B and Lite 9B.
*   Local chat and saved sessions.
*   The model picker and model downloads.
*   An 8K context window per conversation.

Nano needs 6 GB of memory and Lite needs 12 GB. Both fit a 16 GB MacBook

A notes and journal app you can talk to. Speak a journal entry, a random thought or a whole ramble. Thinkdown writes it up in your words and keeps it, so you can find it, reread it and ask about it later.

*   Daily journal

*   Ideas
*   To-dos
*   After a meeting
*   Gratitude
